quotes.text: Our Overtime Merlot 2021 stands out as one of the best wines we've made!

quotes.source: interview, on the wine most likely to be underestimated

quotes.text: Thank you for supporting a family owned and operated winery from our own backyard here in Canada!

facts.fact: Founded 2003 as a winery, 1972 as grape growers
Head Winemaker Vadim Chelekhov started as an amateur winemaker at 14; winemaking became his profession in 2011
Grapes come from Neufeld Farm (vineyard name on every tasting note); an owning family name is not stated in any source
'Wine is the fruit of labour' is printed on the Overtime labels
Vadim says Niagara reds can rival those from the world's biggest regions; the portfolio is broad with many easy, approachable, great-value wines

lineup_source: Drive 2026.10 - Palatine Hills / 3.Winery LineUp_PalatineHills.xlsx, tab 'Revised Lineup'

wines.name: Overtime Sauvignon Blanc

oak.claim: sixteen months in older French oak

wines.winery_words: Sixteen months in older French oak gives another dimension without losing freshness. Grapefruit, gooseberry, apple and tropical fruit meet subtle creaminess (Revised Lineup sheet).
wines.expert_notes: Dry, medium-bodied, herbal and grassy, gooseberry nose, green plum, firm lightly bitter finish. Drink now. (Aspler 88)

wines.name: Overtime Chardonnay

oak.claim: two years in older French oak

wines.winery_words: Two years in older French oak builds richness without letting oak take over. Ripe peach, pear, mango, buttery pastry (sheet). Vadim: silky smooth buttery texture, clean crisp mineral finish, tropical fruit, poached pear, fresh brioche, light honey (interview).
wines.expert_notes: Full-bodied, dry, viscous, toasty apple, buttery note, touch of bitterness. Drink now and through 2027. (Aspler 88)

wines.name: Lakeshore Viognier
wines.winery_words: Wonderfully aromatic without needing sweetness. Stone fruit and lavender, soft rounded palate, fresh acidity (sheet).
wines.expert_notes: Aromatic, medium-to-full-bodied, honeysuckle and peach, floral, peach and muskmelon. Drink now. (Aspler 89)

wines.name: Lakeshore Pinot Grigio
wines.winery_words: Uncomplicated in the best way. Crisp citrus, apple, green melon, subtle tropical lift; refreshing, approachable, easy to reach for (sheet).
wines.expert_notes: Easy-drinking, medium-bodied, spicy peach, floral, peach-melon. Drink now. (Aspler 89, Spooner 88)

wines.name: Lakeshore Merlot
wines.winery_words: Doesn't demand a special occasion. Juicy raspberry, dark cherry, blueberry, warm spice, soft texture, savoury edge (sheet).
wines.expert_notes: Juicy, medium-to-full-bodied, spicy plum and currant, vanilla oak. Drink now or hold 1 to 2 years. (Aspler 91)

wines.name: Overtime Merlot

oak.claim: wrapped in French oak (no duration stated)

wines.winery_words: Captures everything that made the outstanding 2020 Ontario vintage so memorable. Ripe plum, blackberry, raspberry, dark chocolate wrapped in French oak; bold yet balanced; rewarding now or cellared (sheet).
wines.expert_notes: Full-bodied, dry, plum and blackcurrant, cedary oak spice, bitter-chocolate finish. Opens now, rewards 1 to 2 years. Drinking window to about 2028. (Aspler 90)

wines.name: Overtime Merlot

oak.claim: four years in premium French oak

wines.winery_words: Vadim's pick of the bottle to open first: one of the best wines we've made; bright red fruit, refined acidity, smooth integrated tannins; four years in premium French oak; plum, dark cherry, cedar, dark chocolate (interview). Elegance from a difficult growing season (sheet).
wines.expert_notes: Medium-to-full-bodied, balanced, firm structure, cedary plum and blackcurrant, oak spice. Hold 1 to 2 years. (Aspler 91, Spooner 89)

wines.name: Overtime Cabernet Sauvignon
wines.winery_words: What this Cabernet says about a challenging Niagara vintage: careful vineyard work and four years in French oak produced a structured, savoury wine; black currant, dark cherry, cedar, graphite, polished tannins (sheet).
wines.expert_notes: Full-bodied, dry, blackcurrant, cedary oak spice, green-pepper finish; hold 1 to 2 years (Aspler 88). Leah Spooner: drink now with a hearty meal (88).

wines.name: Overtime Meritage

oak.claim: only our strongest barrels were chosen for this blend

wines.winery_words: Only our strongest barrels were chosen for this blend. Black cherry, blackberry, dried plum, dark chocolate, mint, toasted oak; round, velvety, long fresh finish (sheet).
wines.expert_notes: 75% Merlot, 25% Cabernet Sauvignon. Medium-to-full-bodied, firm, blackcurrant and redcurrant, polished oak spice. Hold 1 to 2 years. (Aspler 91)

wines.name: Overtime Reserve Merlot

oak.claim: only the finest barrels, aged for more than three years in French oak

wines.winery_words: (The sheet's insight text for this wine repeats the 2021 Merlot's; not used.)
wines.expert_notes: 100% Merlot. Full-bodied, dry, blackberry and black plum, cedary spice, ripe firm tannins. Drink now or through 2028. (Aspler 92) Nose: cedary and spicy, with black plum and black cherry.

wines.name: Overtime Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon

oak.claim: barrel-selected lots from the 2020 vintage, aged for more than three years in French oak

wines.winery_words: (The sheet's insight text for this wine repeats the 2021 Cabernet's; not used.)
wines.expert_notes: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon. Bold, extracted ripe black fruit, cedary spice, vanilla oak, fresh acidic finish. Drink now or hold a couple of years. (Aspler 90) Nose: cedary and spicy, with blackcurrant and vanilla oak notes.

wines.name: Overtime Traditional Method Sparkling Brut Nature

oak.claim: more than ten years on lees

wines.winery_words: The patience behind this wine: more than ten years on lees transformed Chardonnay from two Niagara vintages into a creamy, bone-dry sparkling wine with toasted brioche, marzipan, citrus (sheet).
wines.expert_notes: 100% Chardonnay, Brut Nature, 0.2 g/L residual sugar. Persistent fine mousse, toasty leesy apple, biscuity, long finish. Drink now. (Aspler 89)

wines.name: Wild & Free 'Savage' Brut
wines.winery_words: (No winery text for this wine in the sheet.)
wines.expert_notes: 100% Chardonnay, traditional method, 5.8 g/L residual sugar. Deep golden, fine subdued mousse, toasty leesy peach bouquet, dried-apricot flavour on fresh acidity, light-to-medium, dry. Drink now through 2027. (Aspler 89)
